title: From Refusal to Redirection After Safety Fine-Tuning
description: A QLoRA experiment with Llama 3.2 3B Instruct examining a refusal-to-redirection shift and a mismatch between data labels and the evaluation rubric.
excerpt: Exact behavioral-label agreement fell after fine-tuning. Of the 487 fine-tuned mismatches, 481 occurred when REFUSE was expected and the judge assigned REDIRECT.
thumbnailAlt: Stacked bars show baseline responses dominated by REFUSE at 72.2 percent and fine-tuned responses dominated by REDIRECT at 80.2 percent across 910 evaluation prompts.
thumbnailCaption: Figure 1. Distribution of behavioral labels assigned by GPT-5.6-Terra to baseline and fine-tuned Llama 3.2 3B Instruct responses across 910 evaluation prompts. Bars show percentages for ANSWER, REFUSE, REDIRECT, and OTHER. The labels describe response style, not substantive safety.
